question: Estimate the TAM for fitness apps (workout + nutrition + wearable-linked) in urban India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Paid TAM only or include free-user advertising potential? Both, with paid as primary.
Standalone fitness apps (Cure.fit, HealthifyMe, Nike Training, Strava) — include OEM apps (Mi Fit, Boat)? Standalone primarily.
Urban only or all-India? Urban (Tier 1 + Tier 2).
Include premium gym/class bookings via app (Cult.fit centers)? Include digital subscription only, not center memberships.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Bottom-up: urban affluent → fitness-conscious segment → willing to pay × ARPU.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Urban India population: ~520M; affluent + middle class: ~250M.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Willing to pay for fitness app subscription at TAM

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~₹1,500/year (₹125/month, blended across HealthifyMe ₹3,000/yr to free Nike/Strava paid plans).

calculationFlow: Urban India population: ~520M; affluent + middle class: ~250M.
Willing to pay for fitness app subscription at TAM: ~50% = ~19M.
Average ARPU: ~₹1,500/year (₹125/month, blended across HealthifyMe ₹3,000/yr to free Nike/Strava paid plans).
Add free-tier ad-supported potential: 38M free users × ₹100/yr ad ARPU = ~₹380 Cr.
